milestones.title: Request received
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows a customer asking for a price or a visit, with the address of the work.

milestones.title: Site visit done
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows a technician visited the site, or the customer sent photos and measurements instead.

milestones.title: Estimate sent
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the priced estimate reaching the customer.

milestones.title: Contract signed
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the customer signing or accepting the estimate in writing. A yes reported by phone is not enough.

milestones.title: Deposit received
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the deposit paid, such as a payment notice or a receipt.

milestones.title: Equipment ordered
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the unit ordered from the supplier, with an expected delivery date when one is given.

milestones.title: Install date set
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows a date the customer agreed to.

milestones.title: Install complete
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the technician reporting the unit installed and running.

milestones.title: Inspection passed
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the town's inspection passed. A booked inspection is pending, not done.

milestones.title: Customer sign-off
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the customer confirming the work is finished to their satisfaction.

milestones.title: Balance paid
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the remaining balance paid.
